shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log --oneline -5 && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"UsageMetadata|afterModelResponse|totalUsage|lastUsage\" src specs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/types/index.ts && sed -n '45,90p' src/index.ts && cat jest.config.js && rg -n \"expectType|satisfies|@ts-expect-error|type .* =.*Usage\" src/*.test.ts src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" src scripts | head -100 && rg -n \"spec:\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -10 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"createProgram|typescript|tsc|compile.*fixture|package.*type\" src scripts | head -100 && cat package.json | sed -n '1,160p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts | sed -n '1,40p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '40,85p' && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/types/ai.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsageType.test.ts src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts && git commit -m "Name aggregate turn usage contract" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
